author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam and Propstore's Brandon Alinger examine two props from Star Wars: The Force Awakens, including one of the hero Luke lightsabers created for the film. They take a close look at the components used to rebuild this iconic prop for the sequel trilogy, which look to include many of the original found parts that were kitbashed to make the original!

Learn more about these props and see more details at: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/496

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
